reason: The Ledger port and SqliteLedger have no recordRunAttempt, endRunAttempt, listRunAttempts, recordEvidence, listEvidence, recordGateResult, listGateResults, upsertWorkItem, transitionWorkItem, listWorkItems, openDecision, listDecisions, recordCheckValidation, getCheckValidations or listHookReads yet, so each call throws TypeError (not a function). tests 51, pass 28 (Tasks 1 and 2), fail 23.

run attempts: gives att_ IDs with ordinals 1 and 2, records an event with run and attempt, and ends an attempt exactly once
refuses an unknown run, an unknown attempt, an empty reason or outcome, and an onboarding carrier
evidence: records every field of the schema and reads it back through the run, oldest first, with an ev_ ID
stores optional fields as null, and a dirty tree as clean false
accepts each of the six statuses and refuses any other as invalid
refuses an independence outside deterministic, external, model-review, and accepts those three
refuses an unknown attempt, an attempt of an onboarding carrier, a non-boolean clean and a non-object environment
is insert-only: an interrupted check is marked by a new inconclusive row, and the database refuses an UPDATE or DELETE (T-02-06)
keeps evidence of different runs apart
gate results: round trips failures_json, passed and the revision, oldest first, and records an event with the run
refuses an empty gate name, a non-boolean passed and an unknown run, and is insert-only
work items: upserts an item at ready, keeps its state on a second upsert, and lists them
applies assertItemTransition, appends a work_item.transition event with the run, and counts delegations as attempts
refuses an invalid edge as invalid, a stale fence as conflict and an unknown item or run as not_found, writing nothing
lets any non-done item move to blocked_on_decision and back to ready, and nothing leave done
refuses a malformed item: empty ID, unknown type, unknown run
decisions: opens a decision in state open with a dec_ ID, an event with the run, and filters by run and state
accepts exactly the eight documented classes and the two urgencies, and refuses anything else
refuses a filter state outside open, answered, stale, withdrawn
check validations: round trips one row per check name and filters by project, revision and spec digest
never overwrites a verdict: a second record for the same key is a conflict that leaves the first
refuses an empty name or verdict
hook reads: lists the rows the hook wrote with its own SQL, by seq, for one invocation
